description: Dry-run a protection card: shows the card that would result after merging with the platform, organization and team policies above it, plus any conflicts. Nothing is saved, and no publish grant is needed.

agent_id.description: The agent this card belongs to (e.g. `smolt-abc123`). Identifier only — never place an API key, a secret, an email address, or any other personal data in this field.

card_version.description: Card schema version. REQUIRED by the server-side validator. Current canonical value: `protection/2026-04-26`.

mode.description: Screening mode for the protection pipeline. Required. `off` disables screening; `observe` records only; `nudge` warns; `enforce` blocks.

protected_surface.description: The assets and operations this agent must protect. Omit to accept the composed default (empty surface).

label.description: Short human-readable name for the asset.

reason.description: Why it is protected, in one short sentence. Do NOT enter personal data (names, email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses), and do NOT enter health, biometric, government-identifier (e.g. SSN) or payment-card data. This text is stored on the agent's governance card and is readable by everyone in the owning organization.

selector.description: Which instance — e.g. "mnemom/mnemom-api". A resource identifier only: no credentials, no connection strings, no personal data.

escalation_required.description: Operations that require human approval before the agent may proceed.

applies_to.description: Asset identities this entry applies to. Omit to apply to every protected asset.

pattern.description: Operation matcher — e.g. "force_push", "drop_table*". A short pattern, not a description.

reason.description: Why this entry exists, in one short sentence. Do NOT enter personal data (names, email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses), and do NOT enter health, biometric, government-identifier (e.g. SSN) or payment-card data. This text is stored on the agent's governance card and is readable by everyone in the owning organization.

forbidden_operations.description: Operations the agent must never perform on the protected assets.

applies_to.description: Asset identities this entry applies to. Omit to apply to every protected asset.

pattern.description: Operation matcher — e.g. "force_push", "drop_table*". A short pattern, not a description.

reason.description: Why this entry exists, in one short sentence. Do NOT enter personal data (names, email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses), and do NOT enter health, biometric, government-identifier (e.g. SSN) or payment-card data. This text is stored on the agent's governance card and is readable by everyone in the owning organization.

severity.description: How serious a violation of this entry is.

screen_surfaces.description: Which traffic surfaces are screened. Required, with all four flags set.

incoming.description: Screen prompts arriving at the agent.

tool_calls.description: Screen the tool calls the agent makes.

tool_responses.description: Screen tool responses returned to the agent.

thresholds.description: Risk-score cutoffs, each in [0, 1] and ordered warn ≤ quarantine ≤ block. Required. Send the full set: a publish replaces the agent's current card rather than patching it.

block.description: Score at or above which the request is refused.

quarantine.description: Score at or above which the request is held for review.

warn.description: Score at or above which the request is flagged.

trusted_sources.description: Sources exempt from screening. Required, with all three lists present; send empty lists to trust nothing extra. Enumerate specific hosts — wildcards are rejected, and a server-side deny-list (public LLM/DNS endpoints, 0.0.0.0/0, ::/0, link-local, multicast) is always applied.

agent_ids.description: Trusted Mnemom agent IDs. Must be in canonical `mnm-*` form.

domains.description: Trusted DNS names, optionally with `:port`. No wildcards.

name: preview_compose_protection_by_agent

composition_valid.description: True when the composed card is valid.

conflicts_count.description: Total number of conflicts detected (0 = none).

full_report.description: Optional pointer to the full /v1 conflict report (method + path).

ok.description: True when composition succeeded (no blocking conflicts).

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of composition status.
